page_title: LEC 1-2 PAR | Lecce v Parma 11/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post!
90+6' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+6' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90+5' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle after Emanuele Valeri (Parma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lecce.
90+4' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Edoardo Corvi.
90+3' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
90+2' Konan Ndri (Lecce) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
84' The substitution has been made. Sascha Britschgi (Parma) has replaced Gaetano Oristanio.
84' A poor finish by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.

84' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) squandered a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the penalty box but only placed the ball against the left post!
83' The free kick is taken by Riccardo Sottil (Lecce), but ball is cleared.
82' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) makes a slide tackle, but referee Livio Marinelli blows for a foul. Lecce win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
80' Here is a change. Adrian Bernabe Garcia is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Christian Ordonez (Parma).
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jacob Ondrejka will be replaced by Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
80' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
78' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Omri Gandelman (Lecce) replacing Youssef Maleh.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ylber Ramadani departs the field of play to be replaced by Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce).
77' That's the end of the game for Corrie Ndaba, who is replaced by Riccardo Sottil (Lecce).
77' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
77' Edoardo Corvi leaps to intercept the corner kick from Konan Ndri (Lecce).
76' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' Total attempts – 8:9. 1:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
73' The attendance is 24587.

72' 1 - 2 Adrian Bernabe Garcia takes over corner duties and expertly finds Mateo Pellegrino (Parma), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the middle of the goal. The score is now 1:2.
72' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
72' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
71' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
70' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
69' This is a yellow card! Enrico Del Prato (Parma) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
69' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. Lecce win a free kick.
68' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
68' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
67' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

66' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Parma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
65' Eusebio Di Francesco makes a tactical change due to a red card. Antonino Gallo comes on in place of Nikola Stulic (Lecce).

64' 1 - 1 Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the left post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
64' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Mandela Keita.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' Crossbar! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
62' A pass by Danilo Veiga (Lecce) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
60' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

56' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off. Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
55' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Lameck Banda (Lecce). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

55' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Lameck Banda (Lecce), but referee Livio Marinelli must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
55' Lameck Banda (Lecce) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee. Lameck Banda (Lecce) will miss the next game.
54' Lameck Banda (Lecce) runs onto a ball from Konan Ndri and tries an ambitious shot from mid-range. The keeper has it covered but it goes just over the bar anyway.
54' Here's the change. Santiago Pierotti leaves the pitch and Konan Ndri (Lecce) comes on as a substitute.
53' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Wladimiro Falcone to dive and make a save.
52' Poor challenge! Lameck Banda (Lecce) is penalised for tripping and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle. Free kick. Parma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
51' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
51' The free kick into the penalty area from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Parma.
50' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Parma have a free kick.

48' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) smashes the ball upfield and Emanuele Valeri brings it down with a fine first touch. Mateo Pellegrino is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Emanuele Valeri (Parma).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

45+1' Adrian Bernabe Garcia almost found himself in a promising position after Emanuele Valeri (Parma) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) receives a reproachful look from Oliver Sorensen. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the right post.
43' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
43' The game is interrupted. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
40' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.

39' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Livio Marinelli blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Parma are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
37' Youssef Maleh sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Tiago Gabriel (Lecce), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
37' Corner kick. Youssef Maleh (Lecce) is ready to send the ball into the box.

36' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Nikola Stulic (Lecce) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
34' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
32' 3:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
30' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Edoardo Corvi intercepts the ball.
29' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
28' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) probably handled the ball.

25' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Emanuele Valeri (Parma) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the bottom right corner, but Wladimiro Falcone answers with a superb save to deny him.
24' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) jumps into a tackle and Livio Marinelli signals a foul. Parma are awarded the free kick.
23' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Livio Marinelli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
23' A free kick into the box, taken by Youssef Maleh (Lecce), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
22' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul. Lecce earn a free kick.
22' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
21' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) picks out Mateo Pellegrino with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
16' 35:65 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
15' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
13' The corner kick is deflected to Lameck Banda (Lecce), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
13' The resulting corner from Youssef Maleh (Lecce) is cleared.
12' Lameck Banda (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner.
11' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
8' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) sends a long cross over to Nikola Stulic, but Edoardo Corvi comes forward to gather the ball.
6' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lecce.
5' A crossfield pass from Lautaro Valenti (Parma) fails to find any of his teammates.
5' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) is penalised for a foul. Livio Marinelli had a clear view and blows his whistle.
1' 1 - 0 Goal! Lameck Banda sends a precise cross into the box, Nikola Stulic (Lecce) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
1' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
